stages.journal: Solvei has written to Veyle every month for years, and Veyle has answered with silence. Now there is a third address: the city the old folk kept, open for the first time in a hundred and fifty years. Solvei will not leave her table. You will. Carry her letter up the *Evenway*, past the last lamp and the first waystone, and hand it to whoever keeps the gate.

Serel read the seal and did not open the letter, which told you something about the gate. She sent you to *Elarin* at the Outward House, because everything that enters Evenfall warms itself at his fire first. That is not a rule. It is just true.

The letter goes up the Moonstair. The *Evenking* reads what crosses his gate in its first season, every word of it, because a hundred and fifty years of quiet taught him what letters cost. Climb the flights and put Solvei's question in the oldest hands in the world.
